notes.title: Relicta: Aegir Gig & Ice Queen – Live Now!
notes.content:
Dear physicist, long time no see! 

A lot has happened in these months, don't think that we haven't been working! To thank you for all your support and love, today we bring you a very special update. 

We’re excited to announce that Relicta: Aegir Gig & Ice queen is live now on Steam! Enjoy this free update, available to all players that include two new adventures on the Chandra Base. More dangers! More mysteries! And, of course, more puzzles! 

Update Notes: 

[h2]Aegir Gig [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/83fef6a8fc76f9272c6b8b5d5ca279cf45182355.png[/img]
 
Play as Nic, a bioengineer tasked with testing the gravitomagnetic interfaces in the environments he helped design for AEGIR Labs years before the events of the main game, with even more challenging puzzles to solve as you experience the Chandra Base in a whole new way. Including: 

12 additional puzzles. 

A completely new story! 

[h2]Ice Queen [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/f588651f5567e3f38b57245c2b65b4499a05a017.png[/img]
 

Follows the events in the main story, as you play as one of the survivors of Chandra Base after the end of Relicta. Alone in the depths of the moon, you will discover: 

A new Bioma. 

12 additional puzzles. 

Two new mechanics. 

Know what happened in the derelict lunar base! 

After updating, you will find this new content on your main menu whatever the status of your game was. However, we recommend having finished the original story to keep up to date with the story and get to know the mechanics as much as possible. The new puzzles have no mercy on anyone...  

Also, to celebrate this launch, enjoy a [b]50% discount[/b] on Relicta! We will be doing some giveaways on our social media during the rest of the month. Stay tuned!

[i]Keep experimenting[/i],
Mighty Polygon

notes.title: Relicta 1.03
notes.content:
Patch #1.03 
[list]
[*] New: Added widescreen support. 
[*] New: Added field of view controls. 
[*] Fixed: Minor improvements and bug fixes. 
[/list]
We've listened to all the feedback you have been leaving us since the launch of the game, which has allowed us to locate bugs and apply improvements to the game.

We have also added support for Widescreen monitors and enabled Field of View changes to help avoid dizziness among players who have this problem.

notes.title: Speedrun Challenge!
notes.content:
[h1]Time to run![/h1]

Hello everyone! Welcome once again!

Today we bring you a [b]new challenge for the Relicta demo[/b]. This time you need to beat the demo in the shortest time possible. You will have the demo available from today to monday[b] (July 17 to 20)[/b]. 

Those of you who haven't tried it yet will have the opportunity to play Relicta for the first time and see how much time you need to overcome it. For those who have already played it... Let the race begin! You can try as many times as you want until you find a score with which you are satisfied.

Take a screenshot of your time and send it to us on any of our social media. You can participate as many times as you want! But only your best score will be count, of course :) 

[h3]Demo time![/h3]
Starts: July 17 15:00 CEST
Finish: July 20 12:00 CEST

[h2]The rules are simple![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/8c022fc873236854c1cf8e91160c7430c246ac50.png[/img]

[h2]What's new on the demo?[/h2]
[h3]Demo 1.3 is here! [/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[*] New graphic settings including FPS limit, Render scale, and the option the see the current FPS in-game. 
[*] Added Tobii Eye Tracking support.
[*] Change the [b]Save Game[/b] file in order to support the continuation in the game upon release from the point you were in the demo.
[*] Now if you beat the demo and press continue upon loading you will see the last time you did.
[*] Added some missing translations for the skip scenes system.
[/list]

[h2]Follow us![/h2]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/MightyPolygon/]Facebook [/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/MightyPolygon]Twitter [/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/mightypolygon/]Instagram [/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/VSTdgue]Join our Discord Server.[/url]

If you have any questions you can leave it here or on any of our social networks. Enjoy!

[i]Keep experimenting![/i]
[b]Mighty Polygon.[/b]

notes.title: Demo 1.2 available now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Demo 1.2 comes with the following updates:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Windows 7 support fixed. 
[*] Added extra save point.
[*] Mouse sensitivity options increased.
[*] Subtitles sizes in multiple languages 
[*] Time limit removed. 
[*] Skip cutscenes added. (You need to hold the Reset button during a cinematic.) 
[/list]
[i]Available till June 6[/i]

[h2]TREASURE HUNT BEGINS![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/9c8ea0abfebaff24e07e915764d928bec1c19009.png[/img]

[h3]How to play:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1 - Find these collectibles on the demo.
[*] 2 - Use other "Photo Mode" or Screenshot them!
[*] 3 - Share them with us on [url=https://twitter.com/MightyPolygon]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/MightyPolygon/]Facebook[/url] and/or [url=https://www.instagram.com/mightypolygon/] Instagram[/url], tagging us and using the hashtag [b]#PlayRelicta.[/b]
[*] 4 - Follow us on the social media you participate in!
[/list]

We will raffle some keys to play the game on the very first day of launching. The more social media you upload them, the more chances to win!

notes.title: Demo 1.1 + Ask me anything!
notes.content:
Hello world! First, thank you for your time playing Relicta!  We’re really excited reading all your feedback and kind words, we really appreciate it.  

We just updated our demo following some of the feedback you left for us. You can now play our demo 1.1 with the following changes: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/d8e9a19f787910b13ac362fdcae0455a7c004b40.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Steam VR fixed: Steam VR is no longer being opened in the background after launching the game. Relicta is currently not available for VR and we don’t know yet if it will be in the future. 
[*] Motion Blur toggle at the menu fixed. 
[*] Added AZERTY keyboard support. 
[*] Added Gamma correction settings at the menu. 
[*] Other minor bugs fixed. 

[/list]
Hope this makes the experience even better! If you have any other complains or feedback, please let us know on our Community Hub 😊 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/41b10f7ed83b71f191624f75cd5e1a604c5f9216.png[/img]

Secondly, friendly reminder that we have our Ask Me Anything today 18:00 PM (CEST). You just need to join our [url=https://discord.gg/VSTdgue]Discord Server[/url] and write your questions at our #ask_me_anything channel. We’ll be answering for two hours and, after that, all the answers will be saved on our #FAQ channel. Don’t be shy! 

Also, thank you very much for joining our stream yesterday! We were +2500 folks playing and enjoying Relicta. We were happy to have you there! 

Keep experimenting! 

Mighty Polygon
